entries.speaker: Teammates' Finishing Throw
entries.en: If you have a low score by [clr 2]round 4[clr 27], your teammate[n]may ask for advice on how they should finish.[n]Answering correctly increases the possibility that[n]they will perform a finishing throw.

entries.speaker: Teammates' Finishing Throw
entries.en: When your teammate finishes in this way,[n]your synergy with that teammate increases,[n]leveling up your [clr 2]Baton Pass rank by 2[clr 27].
